svg.title: Heavenly Sonata — Music of the Spheres. Draft 1 / Yin-Yang classification / forked tree.
svg.desc: 10 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Opening Measure forks into Rising Crescendo then Fortissimo Finale, or Dissonant Chord then Prelude to Ruin. Harmonic Balance forks into Wall of Sound then Celestial Sanctum, or Muted Strings then Final Rest. No paths converge. Bonuses affect existing supported tags on Yin-Yang-classified Heavenly Sonata jutsu.

Three of the seven supported rows are Yin-Yang Genjutsu Damage on 60 AP casts (Foreboding Interlude 40, Frozen Melody 45, Lullaby 40 at jutsu level 25), so offense is a full secondary route at the Taiyo Kami +5 scale. Foreboding Interlude's 35% exposure (Genjutsu-filtered, element-less) and Lullaby's 35% self buff (all four stat types, element-less) are the tertiary amplifiers: exposure gets a route held to +7, empowerment is Foundation-plus-capstone glue capped at +5 because that buff reaches every hit the caster lands. No Afterburn, Lifesteal, Reflect, Heal or Increase Heal row exists, so none is invented."},"nodes":[{"id":"01","name":"Opening Measure","category":"Foundation","cost":1,"parents":[],"modifiers":[{"tag":"increasedamagegiven","flat":2,"display_role":"SELF BUFF"},{"tag":"increasedamagetaken","flat":2,"display_role":"ENEMY DEBUFF"}],"flavor":"Every sonata begins with a single measure that decides how the rest will fall.","coverage_note":"Lullaby self buff 35\u219237% (all four stat types, element-less: every hit); Rest"]}],"narrow_kit_exception":null,"design_notes":["Node split: the Damage route (+2 Hidden, +3 Advanced) reaches the three Yin-Yang attacks as Taiyo Kami's does and is the highest row-weighted build (23 on 7 rows; Taiyo 31 on 9). Single-row percentage tags carry the larger flats: Increase Damage Taken is held to +7 (2/2/3); Decrease Damage Taken and Decrease Damage Given reach +10 (2/3/5). Increase Damage Given is glue only (+2 Foundation, +3 on Prelude to Ruin; +5 ceiling) because Lullaby's buff reaches every hit the caster lands.","Capstone secondaries: the tank capstones each take +2 of the other's tag (Celestial Sanctum +2 Decrease Damage Given, Final Rest +2 Decrease Damage Taken), below the sibling Hidden Arts' +3, so the fortress/suppression hybrid (01, 06, 07, 09) is never dominated and neither tank capstone is an offensive buy. Prelude to Ruin takes +3 Increase Damage Given; Fortissimo Finale is Damage-only. An Increase Damage Taken secondary on Final Rest would dominate 01, 04, 06, 09; rejected.","Downstream reach: the bloodline passive (Increase Damage Given 25% + 0.15/level on Fire, Lightning, Yin-Yang, None) is not a potency target but multiplies the enhanced Yin-Yang damage. Lullaby's buff and Harmonic Chamber's suppression list all four stat types, no element: the buff raises every hit the caster lands and the suppression lowers every non-pierce hit the target deals. Interlude's exposure lists only Genjutsu: Yin-Yang Genjutsu and element-less hits, not elemental Nin/Tai/Buki.","Delivery: all five jutsu are cooldown 7. Foreboding Interlude, Frozen Melody and Lullaby are 60 AP, range 4 (Melody is an enemy-only AOE_CIRCLE_SPAWN with an unsupported 2-round stun; Lullaby's self buff still needs an enemy target in range). Celestial Harmony Shield and Harmonic Chamber are 40 AP; the Shield is a SELF AOE_CIRCLE_SPAWN, range 0, no move row, so its reduction is re-applied each round to a caster standing in the circle; cast-round application and window overlaps were not verified.","Fourth purchases: Burst takes Harmonic Balance (37%/37% defensive glue) or Dissonant Chord (39% exposure); Exposure takes Harmonic Balance or Rising Crescendo (+2 power); Fortress takes Muted Strings (42% suppression, pure tank) or Opening Measure (37% buff and exposure); Suppression takes Opening Measure or Wall of Sound (42% reduction, circle only). All 14 full-budget allocations are reported by the validator; see the audit for dominance.","Ten nodes are justified by five supported tags on seven rows across four distinct roles (burst, exposure, fortress, suppression); no node is a reskin of another, and four examples are given because each Advanced Art is a different tag and role. Stun, drain, shield, buffprevent and cleanseprevent are unsupported and untouched; no Afterburn, Lifesteal, Reflect, Heal or Increase Heal row exists, so none is invented."],"risks":["Classification: Yin-Yang is the single signature element but not exclusive in the census (8 collisions: INCLUDE Ethereal Monarch, Tenohira Musei; DEFER Celestial Mage, DvEM, Manhattan Project, Tenry\u016bseigan, Tenshin Shoden Yami-Ryu; EXCLUDE Ethereal Regent); the tree assumes bloodline-scoped classification. Normal-jutsu Yin-Yang use is unverified; the resolver matches 3 of 7 rows directly.","Shield circle uptime: the Decrease Damage Taken row is a SELF row on an AOE_CIRCLE_SPAWN (range 0, no move row). Per the ground-circle reading it is re-applied each round only while the caster stands in the tiles; whether a SELF-target spawn applies on the cast round was not read. Harmonic Balance, Wall of Sound, Celestial Sanctum and Final Rest's +2 depend on standing still; not simulated.","Breadth of the tank rows: Harmonic Chamber's suppression and the Shield's reduction list all four stat types with no element, so at the pin every non-pierce hit qualifies. 45% suppression on a 40 AP cast lowers the target's damage against allies too for 2 rounds, with cleanseprevent (1 round) guarding it from removal and drain 210 beside it; the PvP value of that lock was not simulated.","Increase Damage Given stacking: the +5 glue adds statically to Lullaby's 35% self buff, which stacks with the bloodline passive (bloodline sources multiply and honour allowBloodlineDamageIncrease) and any main-tree or gear modifiers; BATTLE_TAG_STACKING is true at the pin. The row lists all four stat types with no element, so the buff reaches every hit the caster lands for 2 rounds. Not simulated.","Exposure reach: Foreboding Interlude's row lists only Genjutsu with no element, so it amplifies the kit's Yin-Yang Genjutsu attacks and every element-less hit from any source (basic attacks, weapons, non-elemental jutsu) but not elemental non-Genjutsu hits from allies or normal jutsu. Damage modifiers skip pierce. The Exposure build's row weight (16) understates its reach on a Genjutsu caster.","Realized value: three of five casts are 60 AP on cooldown 7, so Interlude's 2-round exposure and Lullaby's 2-round buff rarely cover all three attacks in one rotation; per-row numbers overstate per-round value. Whether the self buff applied by Lullaby affects that same cast's damage row was not verified.","Frozen Melody is an AOE_CIRCLE_SPAWN with friendly fire ENEMIES, so it is not an ally hazard; its stun is unsupported and unchanged. It is the kit's only multi-target reach, so +5 on its 45 damage is the largest raw gain in the tree. Skill-tree effects are skipped in RANKED_PVP and RANKED_SPARRING at the pin."],"progression":{"currency":"Bloodright Point","abbreviation":"BP","acquired_with":"silver","acquisition_cap":4,"node_cost":1,"silver_price":null,"ownership_gate":"current bloodline","separate_from_normal_skill_points":true},"evaluation_level":25,"game_source_pin":"16498fd776fad9c91e4b84efed4380fe3a487050","snapshot":{"public_kit_snapshot":"2026-10-01T14:58:45.422376+00:00","hidden_kit_snapshot":"2026-09-30"},"audit":{"available_skills":10,"foundation_count":2,"hidden_art_count":4,"advanced_art_count":4,"bloodright_point_cap":4,"cost_per_skill":1,"maximum_advanced_arts":1,"minimum_two_advanced_cost":5,"maximum_parents_per_node":1,"maximum_depth":3,"legal_allocations_by_size":{"0":1,"1":2,"2":5,"3":10,"4":14},"full_budget_allocations":14,"non_dominated_full_allocations":14,"all_nodes_in_non_dominated_builds":true,"nodes_absent_from_non_dominated_builds":[],"maximum_tag_bonuses":{"damage":5,"increasedamagegiven":5,"decreasedamagegiven":10,"increasedamagetaken":7,"decreasedamagetaken":10},"supported_rows_in_kit":7,"supported_rows_by_tag":{"damage":3,"decreasedamagegiven":1,"decreasedamagetaken":1,"increasedamagegiven":1,"increasedamagetaken":1},"tags_targeted_by_tree":["damage","decreasedamagegiven","decreasedamagetaken","increasedamagegiven","increasedamagetaken"],"supported_tags_in_kit_not_targeted":[],"revision":"Draft 1 / Yin-Yang classification / forked tree","source_snapshot":"2026-10-01T14:58:45.422376+00:00","limits":["Proposed potency classification behavior; not implemented or verified in the live engine.","All existing supported tags of Heavenly Sonata jutsu inherit Yin-Yang potency eligibility; original combat elements and target scopes stay intact.","Every matching row on a jutsu receives each matching modifier; repeated rows are counted separately.","Damage values are raw power, not final-damage percentages; percentage-valued tags are capped at 100.","Afterburn is an enemy debuff: for its existing duration, damage the target takes causes extra Afterburn damage at its percentage (60% cap per hit). It is not itself a damage instance; downstream instances were not simulated.","Unsupported tags (e.g. wound, shield, stun, pierce, absorb, poison, drain, summon) receive no bonuses.","No combat simulation. Budget and numerical non-dominance checks do not establish equal combat strength.","Main-tree effects, bloodline passives, equipment, AP, uptime and modifier delivery are outside this audit."]},"legal_full_budget_builds":[{"ids":["01","02","03","04"],"bonuses":{"damage":5,"increasedamagegiven":2,"increasedamagetaken":4}},{"ids":["01","02","03","06"],"bonuses":{"damage":5,"increasedamagegiven":2,"decreasedamagegiven":2,"increasedamagetaken":2,"decreasedamagetaken":2}},{"ids":["01","02","04","05"],"bonuses":{"damage":2,"increasedamagegiven":5,"increasedamagetaken":7}},{"ids":["01","02","04","06"],"bonuses":{"damage":2,"increasedamagegiven":2,"decreasedamagegiven":2,"increasedamagetaken":4,"decreasedamagetaken":2}},{"ids":["01","02","06","07"],"bonuses":{"damage":2,"increasedamagegiven":2,"decreasedamagegiven":2,"increasedamagetaken":2,"decreasedamagetaken":5}},{"ids":["01","02","06","09"],"bonuses":{"damage":2,"increasedamagegiven":2,"decreasedamagegiven":5,"increasedamagetaken":2,"decreasedamagetaken":2}},{"ids":["01","04","05","06"],"bonuses":{"increasedamagegiven":5,"decreasedamagegiven":2,"increasedamagetaken":7,"decreasedamagetaken":2}},{"ids":["01","04","06","07"],"bonuses":{"increasedamagegiven":2,"decreasedamagegiven":2,"increasedamagetaken":4,"decreasedamagetaken":5}},{"ids":["01","04","06","09"],"bonuses":{"increasedamagegiven":2,"decreasedamagegiven":5,"increasedamagetaken":4,"decreasedamagetaken":2}},{"ids":["01","06","07","08"],"bonuses":{"increasedamagegiven":2,"decreasedamagegiven":4,"increasedamagetaken":2,"decreasedamagetaken":10}},{"ids":["01","06","07","09"],"bonuses":{"increasedamagegiven":2,"decreasedamagegiven":5,"increasedamagetaken":2,"decreasedamagetaken":5}},{"ids":["01","06","09","10"],"bonuses":{"increasedamagegiven":2,"decreasedamagegiven":10,"increasedamagetaken":2,"decreasedamagetaken":4}},{"ids":["06","07","08","09"],"bonuses":{"decreasedamagegiven":7,"decreasedamagetaken":10}},{"ids":["06","07","09","10"],"bonuses":{"decreasedamagegiven":10,"decreasedamagetaken":7}}]}

g.text: Draft 1 / Yin-Yang classification / forked tree · Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
Every Heavenly Sonata jutsu: existing supported tags qualify; combat scope stays unchanged.
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
Prelude to Ruin path + Harmonic Balance
IDG: Increase Damage Given · DDG: Decrease Damage Given · IDT: Increase Damage Taken · DDT: Decrease Damage Taken
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
Proposed whole-kit potency classification. Current effect-element matching alone does not provide this inheritance.
14 legal four-skill allocations · 4 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
